name: colonova-confluence-kit
description: Continuous maintenance and freshness management for the 8.8 ColoNova Confluence tree via an audit→refresh loop: colonova-folder-audit builds the refresh and execution queues, and colonova-doc-router-publisher runs the actual updates from those page IDs. Covers routing, audit, freshness/staleness (living standards, 07 monitoring SLO/threshold pages, Approved design reviews, 09 living roadmaps), pending-supersession (05/08/12/ADR), incomplete-discussion-closure and new-subfolder-drift detection, single and batch refresh, supersession with inbound-link reconciliation, and approval-gated publishing.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain, refresh, route, and audit ColoNova Confluence docs
interface.longDescription: Two focused skills that form an audit→refresh maintenance loop for the 8.8 ColoNova Engineering Confluence tree: colonova-folder-audit builds the refresh and execution queues, and colonova-doc-router-publisher runs the actual updates from those page IDs. colonova-folder-audit performs read-only tree audits, freshness/staleness detection of living standards, 07 monitoring SLO/threshold pages, Approved design reviews and 09 living roadmaps, pending-supersession (05/08/12/ADR) and incomplete-discussion-closure sweeps, stale-review-workflow detection for Under Review design reviews, SSOT-vs-live folder gap detection and new-subfolder drift detection, and execution queue planning on a recurring cadence (sprint-close and monthly, automatable via /schedule) — each report self-anchors with an audit-meta block and a next-recommended-run date, saves as colonova-audit-YYYY-MM-DD.md, and auto-links the most recent prior report for delta and overdue checks. colonova-doc-router-publisher routes drafts, rewrites them with type-specific templates (analysis, design, design review, meeting notes, discussion, technical reference, ADR, decision, operating guide, solution, scheduling), refreshes any page carrying a change-history table while appending change-history rows (single or batch refresh of an audit's refresh queue, with a per-page version re-fetch immediately before each write to avoid 409 conflicts), pre-fetches version.number and retries transient 429s, determines ADR numbers with paginated subfolder enumeration and a fetch-failure fallback and handles ADR status transitions, closes discussions into decisions, handles supersession of ADRs, decision pages and operating-guide runbooks with CQL inbound-link reconciliation (URL, title, and page-id passes, with a result-limit cap warning) and continue-past-failure partial recovery, and publishes only after explicit approval with readback verification.

Check the 8.8 ColoNova tree for incomplete supersessions, unresolved discussions, and Under Review design reviews stalled past 90 days
